title: Profile field synchronization
sourceDescription: Choose which sources can update profile fields. Pausing synchronization keeps saved values and does not pause sign-in. Availability is controlled by deployment settings; it does not indicate connection health.

sourceHelp.Proof: Uses personal data verified during sign-in.
sourceHelp.Stage1: Uses data from the linked organization directory.

manualPlaceholders.Nickname: Enter the full display name to keep
manualPlaceholders.FirstName: Enter the given name to keep
manualPlaceholders.JobTitle: Enter the job title to keep
manualPlaceholders.EmployeeId: Enter the organization account identifier to keep

deploymentDisabled: Ask a deployment administrator to enable and trust this source.

firstNameFallback.title: FirstName fill strategy
firstNameFallback.label: Use the full name to fill a missing first name
firstNameFallback.help: Applies at next sign-in; keeps existing values and manually fixed blanks.
firstNameFallback.authority: Saved only for this exact namespace. Deployment (.env) enablement and trust remain required; this setting cannot activate or trust a source. Changes apply during the next eligible sign-in synchronization; pausing synchronization keeps this selection.
firstNameFallback.mapping: Off by default. Prefer assured givenName from this source. Only when givenName is missing, empty or whitespace, use this same source's assured whole displayName to fill a blank FirstName. Existing names and manually fixed blanks are preserved, even when source overwrite is allowed. Names are not split and LastName is not filled by this strategy.

ownership: Account and Person settings are separate. A shared Person field keeps its assigned account as owner; another linked account cannot take ownership here.
preserve: Existing nonempty unattributed values are preserved. Empty, missing or whitespace source values make no change.
overwriteEnabled: Explicit source overwrite is allowed after unlock. Missing or whitespace source values still make no change.
manualHelp: Leave empty to clear and fix. Source updates keep this value until you explicitly unlock it.
assignmentHelp: Choose an existing binding for this record. Unavailable bindings cannot be selected.
sourcePermission: Reading system settings is required to select a source. You can still set a fixed value.
noBindings: This target has no available established source binding.
overwrite: Allow this source to replace existing nonempty unattributed values after unlock
noClear: Sources do not distinguish a missing value from an instruction to clear a field, so source clearing is unavailable. To clear a field yourself, leave the manual value empty and save it as fixed.
timing: Assignment and unlock do not fetch upstream values immediately. Eligible values apply during the next normal synchronization. Pause retains values, configuration and bindings.
readOnly: Read-only access. Updating this target requires its update permission.
assignmentTiming: Applies at the next normal sync; keeps manual protection.

errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again before continuing.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this policy operation, or the request verification token has expired. Reload and try again.
errors.conflict: The policy changed elsewhere. Reload the current policy before applying your change again.
errors.source_unavailable: The source is disabled, untrusted or paused. Reload its status and check deployment configuration.
errors.binding_mismatch: This source identity is no longer bound to this target. Reload the available bindings.
errors.owner_mismatch: This Person field belongs to another account. This operation cannot transfer ownership.
errors.source_clear_unsupported: This source does not support authoritative field clearing.
errors.manual_value_required: Enter a value, or leave the input empty to deliberately clear and fix it.
errors.value_too_long: The value exceeds this field's length limit. Shorten it and try again.
errors.not_found: This target no longer exists. Close this dialog and refresh the list.
errors.invalid_stored_state: The saved policy cannot be read safely. Ask an administrator to inspect its stored state.
errors.unsupported_field_or_operation: This field or policy operation is not supported.
errors.request_failed: The policy request failed. Reload and try again.
